statement: Taiwan and China are a significant share of revenue and host critical suppliers and assembly partners
quote: In addition, geopolitical tensions, such as those involving Taiwan and China, which comprise a significant portion of our revenue and where we have suppliers, contract manufacturers, and assembly partners who are critical to our supply continuity, could have a material adverse impact on us.

statement: Has entered prepaid manufacturing and capacity agreements with suppliers
quote: With these additions, we have also entered and may continue to enter into prepaid manufacturing and capacity agreements to supply both current and future products.

statement: Direct Customers A, B and C were 12%, 11% and 11% of FY2025 revenue
quote: Sales to direct Customers A, B and C represented 12%, 11% and 11% of total revenue, respectively, for fiscal year 2025, all of which were primarily attributable to the Compute & Networking segment.

statement: An indirect customer was an estimated 10%+ of FY2025 revenue
quote: For fiscal year 2025, an indirect customer which primarily purchases our products through system integrators and distributors, including through Customer B, is estimated to represent 10% or more of total revenue, attributable to the Compute & Networking segment.

statement: AI market position has drawn regulator interest in the EU, US, UK, South Korea and China
quote: Our position in markets relating to AI has led to increased interest in our business from regulators worldwide, including the European Union, the United States, the United Kingdom, South Korea and China.

statement: French Competition Authority inquiry into graphics card and cloud markets
quote: For example, the French Competition Authority collected information from us regarding our business and competition in the graphics card and cloud service provider market as part of an ongoing inquiry into competition in those markets.

statement: Competition regulators in the EU, US, UK, China and South Korea have requested information
quote: We have also received, and continue to receive, broad requests for information from competition regulators in the European Union, the United States, the United Kingdom, China, and South Korea regarding our sales of GPUs and other NVIDIA products, our efforts to allocate supply, foundation models and our investments, partnerships and other agreements with companies developing foundation models, the markets in which we compete and our competition, our strategies, roadmaps, and efforts to develop, market, and sell hardware, software, and system solutions, and our agreements with customers, suppliers, and partners.

statement: EU AI Act effective August 1, 2024, fully applicable after two years
quote: For example, the EU AI Act became effective on August 1, 2024 and will be fully applicable after a two-year transitional period.

statement: Sanctions after the war in Ukraine blocked products into Russia, Belarus and parts of Ukraine
quote: For example, in response to the war in Ukraine, the United States and other jurisdictions imposed economic sanctions and export control measures which blocked the passage of our products, services and support into Russia, Belarus, and certain regions of Ukraine.

statement: The US has imposed worldwide controls restricting GPUs
quote: The United States has imposed unilateral worldwide controls restricting GPUs and associated products, and it is likely that additional unilateral or multilateral controls will be adopted.

statement: Chinese regulators inquired about China supply and Mellanox acquisition commitments
quote: Regulators in China have inquired about our sales and efforts to supply the China market and our fulfillment of the commitments we entered at the close of our Mellanox acquisition.

entities: regulation:EU Code of Practice for General Purpose AI;regulator:European Commission
statement: EU GPAI Code of Practice may require notifying the European Commission
quote: For example, regulation adopted in response to the European Union Code of Practice for General Purpose Artificial Intelligence could require us to notify the European Commission regarding details of some of our Trustworthy AI processes related to our risk framework.

statement: Defending a securities class action over 2017-2018 crypto-mining demand statements
quote: For example, we are defending a securities class action lawsuit from multiple shareholders asserting claims that we and certain of our officers made false and/or misleading statements related to channel inventory and the impact of cryptocurrency mining on GPU demand in 2017 and 2018.

statement: An indirect customer was an estimated 10%+ of FY2025 revenue (MD&A)
quote: For fiscal year 2025, an indirect customer which primarily purchases our products through system integrators and distributors, including through Direct Customer B, is estimated to represent 10% or more of total revenue, attributable to the Compute & Networking segment.

statement: Sales to customers outside the US were 53% and 56% of revenue in FY2025 and FY2024
quote: Revenue from sales to customers outside of the United States accounted for 53% and 56% of total revenue for fiscal years 2025 and 2024, respectively.
